status.scope_reason: The company commercially markets generic finished dosage formulations of sacubitril and valsartan tablets in the United States.
status.evidence: According to DailyMed, Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited holds FDA approvals and lists active U.S. National Drug Codes for generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets distributed by Macleods Pharma USA, Inc.

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited received U.S. FDA approval on October 16, 2024, for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA 213728) for oral tablets of sacubitril and valsartan.
claims.source: U.S. FDA Prescription and Over-the-Counter Drug Product List (Orange Book)

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited's approved generic sacubitril and valsartan oral tablet formulation is listed across 3 standard active strengths in the FDA Orange Book.
claims.source: U.S. FDA Prescription and Over-the-Counter Drug Product List (Orange Book)

claims.claim: The FDA National Drug Code (NDC) Directory listings cover Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited's sacubitril and valsartan film-coated oral tablets in 24/26 mg, 49/51 mg, and 97/103 mg strengths.
claims.source: FDA National Drug Code Directory & DailyMed Labeling

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited's FDA-listed generic Sacubitril and Valsartan drug products are documented under National Drug Codes including NDC 33342-570 for the oral tablet form.

DailyMed documentation verifies that Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited's approved generic sacubitril and valsartan oral tablets are manufactured in strengths including 24 mg/26 mg and 49 mg/51 mg under ANDA 213728. DailyMed (.gov) +2

Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures its generic sacubitril and valsartan film-coated oral tablets under its approved Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA 213728) at its production facility located in Baddi, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh, India, as documented by the National Institutes of Health DailyMed database.
claims.source: NIH DailyMed database and U.S. FDA drug product listings for ANDA 213728.

claims.claim: Macleods Pharma was documented as an upcoming supplier releasing generic sacubitril/valsartan formulations in 24mg/26mg, 49mg/51mg, and 97mg/103mg tablet strengths in the U.S. market, according to an August 2025 release notice by Carlisle Medical.
claims.source: Carlisle Medical release notice titled 'Launch of Generic Entresto (sacubitril/valsartan) Tablets' dated August 5, 2025.

claims.claim: The company reports that in 2020 it completed several block capacity expansions for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosage formulations, which included launching a new manufacturing facility exclusively dedicated to supplying the U.S. market, according to the official corporate website.
claims.corrected: The company reports that 2020 marked the culmination of several block capacity expansions of its facilities for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosages, which included unveiling a brand-new manufacturing facility for finished dosages exclusively for the U.S. market, according to the official corporate website.
claims.source: Official Macleods Pharmaceuticals corporate website (USA geography section).

claims.claim: The company's manufacturing facility in Baddi, India, which is responsible for production of its sacubitril and valsartan tablets, underwent a U.S. FDA drug quality assurance inspection that concluded on October 20, 2023, and was designated as Voluntary Action Indicated, according to the U.S. FDA inspection database. DailyMed (.gov) +5
claims.source: U.S. FDA Inspection Database records for Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited in Baddi, India, indicating an inspection end date of 2023-10-20 with a classification of Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI).

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited obtained final U.S. FDA approval for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) ANDA213728 for generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets on October 16, 2024.
claims.source: U.S. FDA Orange Book and Approved Drug Products database entry for ANDA 213728.

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited holds an active bulk drug listing under National Drug Code (NDC) 33342-0605-31 for sacubitril-valsartan 4 kg/4 kg manufacturing powder.

Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited registered active commercialization labels under NDC codes 33342-570, 33342-571, and 33342-572 for finished oral film-coated tablets with a marketing start date of October 16, 2024.
claims.corrected: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited registered active commercialization labels under NDC codes 33342-570, 33342-571, and 33342-572 for finished oral tablets with a marketing start date of October 16, 2024.
claims.note: The tablets are standard oral tablets, not film-coated oral films.
claims.source: DailyMed (National Institutes of Health) / National Drug Code (NDC) Directory

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited resolved a historical September 2019 FDA Warning Letter concerning current good manufacturing practice (cGMP) violations at its Mandideep Unit-1 facility by July 2023. DailyMed (.gov) +6
claims.corrected: Lupin Limited resolved a historical September 2019 FDA Warning Letter concerning current good manufacturing practice (cGMP) violations at its Mandideep Unit-1 facility by July 2023.
claims.note: The September 2019 Warning Letter for the Mandideep Unit-1 facility was issued to Lupin Limited, not Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited.
claims.source: US FDA Warning Letters Archive / Rakesh Jhunjhunwala Pharmaceutical Sector Report

claims.claim: Macleods Pharma USA Inc. operates dedicated product quality, adverse event reporting, and medical inquiry telephone lines (1-855-926-3384 and 1-888-943-3210) to provide technical support to U.S. healthcare providers and consumers, as detailed on the company's official website.
claims.source: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Official Website (Contact Us / USA Pages)

claims.claim: Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited received US FDA approval under ANDA 213728 for its generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets (24/26 mg, 49/51 mg, and 97/103 mg strengths), which were released in the U.S. market in August 2025; source: Drugs.com / Carlisle Medical

Macleods Pharmaceuticals Ltd. shipped a cargo consignment of Sacubitril 97mg Valsartan 103mg tablets from Mundra, India, to Northstar Distribution Center, arriving on September 26, 2026, as documented in U.S. import activity logs.
claims.note: specific cargo consignment details and arrival date of September 26, 2026

claims.claim: Macleods Pharma USA, Inc. distributes its generic sacubitril/valsartan tablets, which are manufactured by Macleods Pharmaceuticals Ltd. and were released following FDA approval in August 2025, from its commercial headquarters located in Princeton, New Jersey, according to DailyMed and Carlisle Medical.
claims.note: exact FDA approval date of August 2025 and Carlisle Medical release references

claims.claim: The company utilizes its established U.S. commercial operations, which was incorporated in 2011 and expanded to achieve over 80 regional U.S. Food and Drug Administration product approvals by January 2026, as reported by the company. DailyMed (.gov) +2 If you wish to explore further details regarding Macleods Pharma USA Inc.,

On 16 October 2024, Macleods Pharmaceuticals Ltd received final U.S. FDA approval for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA 213748) for generic Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets in 24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, and 97 mg/103 mg strengths, which are bioequivalent and therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug, Entresto.
claims.corrected: On 16 October 2024, Macleods Pharmaceuticals Ltd received final U.S. FDA approval for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA 213728) for generic Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets in 24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, and 97 mg/103 mg strengths, which are bioequivalent and therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug, Entresto.
